messages.author: dbc3325e3846f67d
messages.subject: Tinn-R problem
parts:
Dear all,

I've been using Tinn-R as my R-script editor. While sending scripts
from Tinn-R to R, Tinn-R provides two ways to connect to R. One is the
R-term embedded in Tinn-R window. The other is Rgui independent
console window.

My question is: while i can send lines of script from tinn-R to the
embedded R-term, I CAN"T send them to the independent Rgui console?

Any thoughts on that?

my pc system: windowsXPpro SP3, tinn-R2.2.0.2 , R2.7.2

Thanks for your help!

Alvin

messages.author: 6b93570afc7be0b5
messages.subject: Re: [CorpLing with R] Tinn-R problem
parts:
Hey Alvin,

I don't know if I understood your question, but I think you can send lines into the RConsole the same way you do it for the R-Term:
Highlight the line, hit the R menu, then SEND, then line (the point-click way).

If you have BOTH RConsole and R-Term open, the line will go to the R-Term window. If you only have RConsole open (thru Tinn-R) the line will go straight to the console.

Did I get this right? Is that what you're trying to do?

A.
